d: Room of Sir Morosus. Further, messy space with many signs that show that a former sailor lives here: ship models, flags, rifles, anchors, fish ribs, takelwerk. Particularly striking that all doors are protected with dense curtains or sacks. Morning hour
A sudden hard blow with a knock on the outer door
Same room. Afternoon of the next day
The barber enters, also solemnly clothed, like a bridal advertiser

The barber goes to the door and brings in Carlotta, Isotta and Aminta, all dressed up, not easily recognizable by changed hairdressing. Carlotta comes as a country girl with bright stockings, colorful bodice, a straw hat, which she holds in her hand embarrassed, Isotta is dressed as a young noble lady somewhat affected, Aminta quite simply like a poor citizen girl. Everyone bows down deeply and humbly
Enter: Vanuzzi disguised as a priest, Morbio costumed with glasses as a notary, with them the housekeeper. Barbier receives her at the door
The housekeeper sneaks out of the room of Morosus
The housekeeper goes away with all signs of despair. Aminta meets Henry and Farfallo, who are dressed as a singing teacher - with a role in the hand - and as a piano companion
The door opens. The barber enters broad-track. Everything becomes silent immediately.

A Vanuzzi, Farfallo, Morbio, the first to appear as Chief Justice with a huge white wig, glasses, the golden chain and the black Wams. The other two dressed as Advocates. Vanuzzi pompously pompously pompously pomping on the floor with the long gold stick
